tagline: A slim 600mm bollard with light to one side or all round.
description: Boulevard Mini is a slender round bollard, 110mm across and 600mm high, for paths, entries and garden edges. Choose 180° light to one side or 360° light all round, through a polycarbonate diffuser. The driver is built in, anchor bolts are supplied, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted round bollard, Ø110 × 600mm. 180° | 360° light emission. Extruded copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Anchor bolts included. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE JK3030 mid-power LEDs. IP65. IK10. Class I.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A round bollard in three heights, designed by Momo Design.
description: Boulevard is a die-cast round bollard by Momo Design, 170mm across and 220, 600 or 1000mm high. Each height comes with 180° light for edges and walls or 360° light for open paths and forecourts, under a solid cap. The driver is built in, anchor bolts are supplied, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted round bollard, Ø170mm. Heights 220 | 600 | 1000mm. 180° | 360° light emission. Die-cast copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Anchor bolts included. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XH-G mid-power LEDs. IP65. IK10. Class I. Designed by Momo Design.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A round bollard with one to four light windows.
description: Sector is a 150mm round bollard in 380, 650 and 1000mm heights. Its head has one to four light windows behind opal tempered glass, giving 90°, 180°, 270° or 360° of light, so you can light just the path side or the whole area around it. The driver is built in, a 1m cable is fitted, and a base plate is available.
specification: Surface-mounted round bollard, Ø150mm. Heights 380 | 650 | 1000mm. 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 light windows. Extruded copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Opal tempered glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XHP70 LED. 1m power cable included. IP66. IK10. Class II. Base plate AC053 ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Matt Black

tagline: A slender round or square bollard with 360° downward light.
description: Promenade is a tall, slim bollard in a round (Ø150mm) or square (140mm) section, 705 or 1005mm high. A COB LED behind a Fresnel diffuser sends light down and all around the base, up to 3100 lumens, which suits promenades, plazas and wide paths. It comes with an anchor flange and threaded bolts, on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted bollard, round Ø150mm | square 140 × 140mm. Heights 705 | 1005mm. 360° downward light. Extruded aluminium body and die-cast aluminium cover, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate Fresnel diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Anchor flange with threaded bolts included. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE CXB 1520 COB LED. Power cable not included. M16 cable gland. IP66. IK10. Class II. Base plate AC053 ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A flat rectangular bollard that washes the ground on one side.
description: Scout is a slim rectangular bollard, 66mm deep, that washes the ground to one side with a low 180° beam through a frosted glass window. Scout Mini is 150mm wide and 700mm high; Scout Medium is 230mm wide and 750mm high. It suits paths, steps and building edges, with the driver built in.
specification: Surface-mounted rectangular bollard. Mini 150 × 66 × 700mm | Medium 230 × 66 × 750mm. 180° floor-washing light. Extruded copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Frosted tempered glass diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XH-G mid-power LEDs. IP65. IK08. Class I.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A compact projector head for a low pole.
description: Coiny Bollard is a compact, coin-shaped projector head that clamps to a slim pole to light planting, signs or facades from low level. It has an 18°, 36° or 60° beam from a single COB LED running direct from mains. The 500mm or 1000mm pole with base, a ground spike and a visor are ordered separately.
specification: Projector head for pole mounting, 156 × 115 × 30mm. Die-cast copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. LUMENS EDC 38C COB LED, direct mains 220–240V 50/60Hz. 1m power cable included. IP66. IK08. Class I. Pole with base AC112 500mm | AC113 1000mm, spike AC044 and visor AC111 ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A low round bollard with downward light, designed by Nava + Arosio.
description: Tron is a low, round bollard by Nava + Arosio, 190mm across and 174mm high, for lighting paths and terraces from close to the ground. A COB LED behind a tough polycarbonate diffuser sends light down to one side (180°) or all around (360°). The driver is built in, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted low round bollard, Ø190 × 174mm. 180° | 360° downward light. Die-cast aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE CXB 1520 COB LED. IP66. IK10. Class II. Designed by Nava + Arosio.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: An L-shaped bollard that lights the ground on one side.
description: Periscope is an L-shaped bollard, 180 × 140mm, in 300, 500 and 750mm heights. Its overhanging head sends asymmetric light down and to one side, which suits paths alongside walls, steps and garden beds. Each height comes in 7W or 14W, with the driver built in and a 0.5m cable fitted.
specification: Surface-mounted L-shaped bollard, 180 × 140mm. Heights 300 | 500 | 750mm. Asymmetric downward light to one side. Extruded aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XP-G2 LEDs. 0.5m neoprene power cable included. M16 cable gland. IP65. IK10. Class I.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Matt Black

tagline: A slim pole bollard with a flared 360° head, designed by Nava + Arosio.
description: Alder is a slim bollard by Nava + Arosio: a 70mm pole topped by a flared 203mm die-cast head that spreads light all around it. It comes in 400, 800 and 1000mm heights, all at 20W and up to 1650 lumens, with the driver built in and a 1.5m cable fitted. An anchorage unit is available.
specification: Surface-mounted pole bollard, head Ø203mm, pole Ø70mm. Heights 400 | 800 | 1000mm. 360° light. Die-cast aluminium head and extruded pole, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XH-G LEDs. 1.5m power cable included. PG11 cable gland. IP66. IK09. Class II. Anchorage unit AC065 ordered separately. Designed by Nava + Arosio.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005
